import Mathlib.Data.Nat.ModEq
import Mathlib.Tactic.IntervalCases
import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith
import Mathlib.Tactic.NormNum

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (a): `7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1` iff `3 ∣ n`, for positive `n`. -/
theorem p09_a (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 ↔ 3 ∣ n := by
  -- rewrite the divisibility in terms of `ModEq`
  have hmod7 : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] ↔ 7 ∣ 2 ^ n - 1 := by
    simpa [Nat.ModEq, Nat.dvd_sub_iff_modEq] using (Nat.modEq_iff_dvd (a := 2 ^ n) (b := 1) (n := 7))
  -- the order of `2` modulo `7` is `3`
  have h2pow3 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by
    norm_num
  -- from the order we get a reduction of the exponent modulo `3`
  have hred : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
    -- write `n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3`
    have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
    -- use `pow_add` and the fact that `2^(3*(n/3)) ≡ 1`
    have hpow : (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      have := (Nat.ModEq.pow h2pow3 (n / 3))
      simpa [pow_mul] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) = 2 ^ (3 * (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3) := by
      simpa [hdecomp, Nat.pow_add] using rfl
    -- turn the equality into a `ModEq`
    have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
      simpa [this]
    -- combine the two `ModEq`s
    have := Nat.ModEq.mul hpow (Nat.ModEq.refl _)
    simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using this
  -- now analyse `n % 3`
  constructor
  · intro hdiv
    have h1 : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 1 := by
      have : (2 ^ n) ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := (hmod7).mpr hdiv
      simpa [Nat.ModEq] using this
    have hcase : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt with h0 h1 h2
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr h2
    rcases hcase with h0 | h1 | h2
    · exact ⟨n / 3, by
        have : n = 3 * (n / 3) := by
          simpa [Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd (by
            have : 3 ∣ n := ⟨n / 3, by
              have := Nat.mod_mul_left_mod n 3
              simpa [Nat.mul_comm] using this⟩; exact this)] using (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
        simpa [this, Nat.mul_comm]⟩
    · have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 2 := by
        have := congrArg (fun m : ℕ => m % 7) (by
          have := (Nat.ModEq.eq_iff_modEq).mp (hred.trans (by
            simpa [Nat.ModEq] using rfl))
          exact this)
        simpa [this] using this
      linarith
    · have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 4 := by
        have := congrArg (fun m : ℕ => m % 7) (by
          have := (Nat.ModEq.eq_iff_modEq).mp (hred.trans (by
            simpa [Nat.ModEq] using rfl))
          exact this)
        simpa [this] using this
      linarith
  · intro hdiv
    rcases hdiv with ⟨k, hk⟩
    have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (3 * k)) [MOD 7] := by
      have : n = 3 * k := hk
      simpa [this]
    have hpow : (2 ^ (3 * k)) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
      have := (Nat.ModEq.pow h2pow3 k)
      simpa [pow_mul] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := this.trans hpow
    exact (hmod7).mp this

/-- IMO 1964 P1 (b): no positive `n` has `7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1`. -/
theorem p09_b (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n) : ¬7 ∣ 2 ^ n + 1 := by
  intro hdiv
  have hmod7 : (2 ^ n) ≡ (-1 : ℤ) [ZMOD 7] := by
    have : (2 ^ n + 1) % 7 = 0 := Nat.mod_eq_zero_of_dvd hdiv
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
      have : ((2 ^ n) + 1) % 7 = 0 := this
      have := Nat.mod_add_mod (2 ^ n) 1 7
      simpa [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by decide : 1 < 7), Nat.add_comm] using this
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (-1 : ℤ).natAbs % 7 := by
      norm_num at this
    simpa [Nat.ModEq, Int.ofNat_natAbs] using this
  -- but `2` has order `3` modulo `7`, so its powers can only be `1,2,4`
  have hvals : (2 ^ n) % 7 ∈ ({1,2,4} : Finset ℕ) := by
    have hred : (2 ^ n) ≡ (2 ^ (n % 3)) [MOD 7] := by
      -- same reduction as in part (a)
      have h2pow3 : (2 : ℕ) ^ 3 ≡ 1 [MOD 7] := by norm_num
      have hdecomp : n = 3 * (n / 3) + n % 3 := (Nat.mod_add_div n 3).symm
      have hpow : (2 ^ (3 * (n / 3))) ≡ (1 : ℕ) [MOD 7] := by
        have := (Nat.ModEq.pow h2pow3 (n / 3))
        simpa [pow_mul] using this
      have : (2 ^ n) = 2 ^ (3 * (n / 3)) * 2 ^ (n % 3) := by
        simpa [hdecomp, Nat.pow_add] using rfl
      have := Nat.ModEq.mul hpow (Nat.ModEq.refl _)
      simpa [Nat.mul_comm, Nat.mul_left_comm, Nat.mul_assoc] using this
    have hrem : n % 3 = 0 ∨ n % 3 = 1 ∨ n % 3 = 2 := by
      have hlt : n % 3 < 3 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by decide)
      interval_cases (n % 3) using hlt with h0 h1 h2
      · exact Or.inl h0
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inl h1
      · exact Or.inr <| Or.inr h2
    rcases hrem with h0 | h1 | h2
    · have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 1 := by norm_num
      simpa [h0] using this
    · have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 2 := by norm_num
      simpa [h1] using this
    · have : (2 ^ (n % 3)) % 7 = 4 := by norm_num
      simpa [h2] using this
  have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ≠ 6 := by
    intro h6
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ∈ ({1,2,4} : Finset ℕ) := hvals
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ∈ ({6} : Finset ℕ) := by
      simpa [Finset.mem_singleton] using h6
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ∈ (Finset.empty : Finset ℕ) := by
      have : (2 ^ n) % 7 ∈ ({1,2,4} ∩ {6} : Finset ℕ) := by
        exact Finset.mem_inter.2 ⟨hvals, by simpa⟩
      simpa [Finset.inter_singleton, Finset.inter_eq_self_of_subset_left (by decide)] using this
    exact Finset.not_mem_empty _ this
  have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = 6 := by
    have : (2 ^ n) % 7 = (-1 : ℤ).natAbs % 7 := by
      simpa using hmod7
    simpa using this
  exact this.elim
